steps.name: Given the admin is logged in
And the admin opens the Team page
And the admin opens the Add category modal
Open the add Team category dialog
When the admin enters "Autotest" into the "Назва" field
And the admin closes the Add category modal
Close the Team category modal with the X icon
Then the Add category "Зміни будуть втрачені. Бажаєте продовжити?" confirmation pop-up is displayed
And the pop-up has the "Так" and "Ні" buttons
And the Add category modal is still open
